steps.name: Owner inline
steps.goal: Wait for the inline web preview. Do not sign in.
steps.done: The actual owner is signed in and the data connection is live.
forbid: Preview sign-in failed. Reload the preview to try again.

steps.name: Owner data write
steps.goal: Tap Save owner note once inside the preview.
steps.done: The owner note appears from the live collection.

steps.name: Owner fullscreen
steps.goal: Tap Full screen web preview once.
steps.done: The same owner and app appear in the in-app fullscreen preview.

steps.name: Reload owner frame
steps.goal: Tap Reload owner preview once inside the fullscreen preview.
steps.done: Reload completes and the owner and saved data remain.

steps.name: Natural token renewal
steps.goal: Wait without tapping for the five-minute production JWT to renew. Stay in the fullscreen preview.
steps.done: The SDK has received a later expiry through the native host and the live data still works.

steps.name: Renewed data write
steps.goal: Tap Save renewed owner note once inside the fullscreen preview.
steps.done: A new note is saved through the renewed app JWT and arrives from the live collection.

steps.name: Return inline
steps.done: The inline owner preview retains the same owner and saved data.

steps.name: Preview logout
steps.goal: Tap Sign out of preview in the footer of the inline preview. Keep the card inline. Do not open fullscreen or move the footer.
steps.done: The inline footer is reachable. The SDK shows a signed-out state and removes owner data.
